title: Field triage: VPC & On-prem weekly status (May 22–28, 2026)
content:
Purpose:
Quick rolling notes for the field triage channel this week. Goal: capture standing issues across active VPC and on-prem installs, short-term mitigation suggestions, and clear action items for the on-call/field team. This is intentionally informal — use it as the single-source for runbook updates and handoff context.

High-level summary (top risks):
- Network path MTU mismatch causing fragmented TLS handshake failures on customer A (EVPN fabric + transit). Impact: ~30% of initial connections to colocated dedicated cluster fail intermittent TLS renegotiation.
- Certificate rotation failure in air-gapped install (Customer B). The rotation job times out against local internal CA due to CRL fetch attempts (no outbound).
- KMS/HSM handshake oddness when using AWS CloudHSM proxy for on-prem connectors (Customer C). Some keys return RETRYABLE_ERROR and trigger retry storms.
- Post-install Redis memory leak in our local routing cache on small footprint nodes (16GB). Repro on customer D staging after ~48 hours under steady traffic.
- Packaging: RHEL9 kernel module dependency missing in 2.1.3 package; causes systemd unit to fail on boot for one-off older nodes.

Standup log (daily snippets):
- 2026-05-22 (Mon)
  - Morning sync: walked Customer A with networking. Confirmed MTU 1600 on transit; customer fabric is 1450. Reproduced fragmenting / TLS aborts by sending 6k SYN with MSS tests.
  - Workaround: set RW_TLS_PMTU_FALLBACK=1 in ingress proxy systemd drop-in (temp fix). Ethan to test rollback impact.
  - Action: open JIRA-4321 (network-triage-customerA) to track long-term: introduce MSS clamp in onboarding ansible.

- 2026-05-23 (Tue)
  - Customer B: cert-rot job timeout. Root cause: rotation attempts to hit http://ocsp.internal.company/cert-meta which times out in air-gapped. Maya prepared patch to short-circuit OCSP/CRL fetching when airgap flag is set.
  - Action: Maya to produce hotfix branch and a small release candidate (rc2) for the cert-rot container. Test in staging Tues night. Linked to JIRA-4399.
  - Customer D: memory profile taken by Samir. Found leak in routing-cache.go: missing Close() on channel when cache miss triggers remote prefetch with context canceled. Samir has PR GH-PR-1203 with fix + stress test.

- 2026-05-25 (Thu)
  - KMS issue (Customer C): CloudHSM proxy logs show sporadic ERR_RETRY (60/min bursts) after 30 minutes of operation. Hypothesis: connection pooling + ephemeral auth token expiry. Temporary mitigation: lower pool size to 2 and add jittered backoff. Jordan validated mitigation in staging.
  - Packaging: RHEL9 issue reproduced on local VM. Plan: add a post-install script to detect missing module and delay service start until kernel deps are satisfied. Will not be in rc2; scheduled for 2.2.0.

- 2026-05-27 (Sat) ad-hoc
  - Emergency call to Customer A midnight PST. Applied RW_TLS_PMTU_FALLBACK, measured connection success climb from 65% to 98% for initial TLS handshake. Still seeing rare reconnects; follow-up with network team for BGP path MTU and EVPN policies.

Diagnostics & logs (what we captured):
- Customer A: tcpdump + application logs attached to JIRA-4321. Key sample: TLS ClientHello length 3600 -> IP frag -> server abort.
- Customer B: cert-rot container logs show repeated CRL/OCSP fetch attempts. After patch, rotation no longer tries outbound fetches in airgap mode.
- Customer D: heap dump and go pprof output attached to GH-PR-1203. Leak reproduced with 2M req/day traffic generator.
- Customer C: CloudHSM proxy logs with connection id traces and timestamps (rotation at 00:00 UTC triggers burst).

Temporary mitigations applied (do not call these final):
- Set RW_TLS_PMTU_FALLBACK=1 on ingress for Customer A cluster (systemd drop-in). Note: this forces fallback logic and may add ~2–5ms CPU overhead per connection.
- Deploy cert-rot rc2 to Customer B staging; manual approval pending for production after smoke tests.
- Reduce CloudHSM pool size to 2 + add jittered backoff in proxy for Customer C (rolled to staging).
- Hotfix PR for routing-cache close path (GH-PR-1203) queued for fast-track review.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Ethan: add MSS clamp option to onboarding Ansible playbook and document in runbook. ETA: 2026-06-03. (JIRA-4321)
- Maya: push cert-rot rc2 to prod after staging smoke (if green). ETA: 2026-05-30. (JIRA-4399)
- Samir: follow up on GH-PR-1203 test flakiness and land when CI passes. ETA: 2026-05-29.
- Jordan: validate CloudHSM proxy change under 24h soak and capture any auth token churn metrics. ETA: 2026-05-31.
- Priya: add note to private-deploy-runbook about airgap rotation behavior and include the short-circuit flag. ETA: 2026-05-28.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Long-term fix for PMTU mismatch: do we enforce MSS clamp on all onboarding or try to teach our LB/proxy to perform dynamic path MTU discovery fallback? Tradeoffs: MSS clamp is quick but masks network misconfig; dynamic PMTUD needs careful testing across EVPN fabrics. (Engineering guidance needed)
- Should cert-rot skip CRL/OCSP by default for air-gapped installs, or provide an opt-in flag? Current lean is opt-in (airgap flag) but ops would prefer safe default.
- KMS/HSM: do we own a token refresh path to avoid retry storms or rely on cloudHSM proxy vendor fix? Need prioritization from Infra.

Runbook updates suggested (quick bullets):
- Add a "PMTU symptoms" troubleshooting section with tcpdump patterns and temp env vars (RW_TLS_PMTU_FALLBACK, RW_MSS_CLAMP).
- Airgap: explicit config flag in values.yaml 'airgap_mode: true' that makes cert-rot skip external revocation checks. Document accompanying security tradeoffs.
- CloudHSM: include recommended connection pool sizing defaults per node size and a sample systemd unit with ResourceLimits for proxy to avoid FD exhaustion.
- Packaging: add a postinstall hook that checks kernel module dependencies on RHEL families and delays service start.

Notes to on-call / handoff for next shift:
- If Customer A symptoms reappear after fallback is removed: capture tcpdump on both sides, tag JIRA-4321, escalate to net-eng and include BGP adjacency snapshot.
- For any cert-rot failures in airgap: collect cert-rot logs + environment variables, push to staging with -airgap flag to confirm behaviour.
- If Redis routing-cache shows >20% mem growth over 24h: temporarily scale to 32GB node and collect pprof.

Meeting cadence & next sync:
- Weekly triage sync Tuesdays 10:00 PT (field triage + SRE + net-eng).
- Ad-hoc escalations via #private-deploy-triage Slack; use PRIORITY-1 tag for customer-impacting outages.

Appendix: helpful commands / snippets
- Dump MTU path: ip route get 8.8.8.8 dev eth0; trace using hping3 --mtu tests.
- Systemd drop-in template (example):
  /etc/systemd/system/redwood-ingress.service.d/99-pmtu.conf\  [Service]\  Environment=RW_TLS_PMTU_FALLBACK=1
- Local airgap cert-rot run (testing): docker run --rm -e AIRGAP=true private/cert-rot:rc2 ./rotate --no-ocsp
- Capture heap: curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > heap.out; go tool pprof --text heap.out

Status summary (short):
- Customer A: mitigated (fallback) — active network follow-up with net-eng.
- Customer B: rc2 ready for staging — awaiting smoke.
- Customer C: proxy mitigation in staging — soak validation ongoing.
- Customer D: leak fix in PR — CI + stress test pending.

If anything else pops up, add to this doc or ping me directly (Priya).
